note: Open, grassy campground on a bluff over Lake Champlain in Ferrisburgh, looking west to the Adirondacks. Lifeguarded swimming pool (no swimming beach); a trail leads out to Button Point, with a nature center, and there is a boat launch at the park's east end. On the Lake Champlain Bikeway. --Claude
